messages:
Anika S: quick preflight — i'm going to rename the staging namespace for the feature branch promote. need a fast sanity check on secrets wiring and SA bindings before i open the PR
Sam H: which namespace name exactly? and which TF module touches the secrets?
Anika S: planning to move from `svc-feature-staging` -> `svc-feature-qa` and update secret paths under vault/apps/feature -> vault/apps/feature-qa. TF change lives in infra/k8s/namespaces/main.tf
Linh T: any service account role changes or just namespace rename? if SA roles change we need the RBAC gate in the promote job
Anika S: SA roles unchanged, just namespace-scoped rolebindings will be re-pointed. still want to validate the kustomize overlays and the CI gating job picks up the new name
Matt K: ran a quick local terraform plan against staging vars, pasted the trimmed plan below — looks safe but double-check secret rotation note:
```
Plan: 1 to add, 1 to change, 0 to destroy.
+ kubernetes_namespace.svc-feature-qa
~ kubernetes_secret.feature-secrets (update in-place)
```
deploy-bot: infra/plan pipeline passed for branch feature/namespace-qa — plan artifact: link (artifact id 7821) :white_check_mark:
Sam H: two small asks: 1) add a comment in the tf module explaining the vault path rename, 2) update the promote pipeline's env var NAMESPACE_BLACKLIST if needed
Anika S: will add the tf comment. about the blacklist — i checked, no entry for svc-feature-staging there today, so promote job shouldn't block. i'll still add a canary label in the overlay: `canary: true`
ops-bot: suggestion — run this after apply to confirm SA tokens and secrets are readable:
```
kubectl -n svc-feature-qa get sa && kubectl -n svc-feature-qa get secrets -o wide
```
Linh T: also add a quick post-promote smoke script in ci-scripts/k8s that curls the health endpoint of the primary pod and checks logs for startup errors. 1min job is fine
Matt K: small nit — ensure the tf state move uses `terraform state mv` if resource addresses change, otherwise we'll get drift. ping me if you want me to do the state op
Anika S: thanks! i'll open PR in ~10m with: tf module comment, overlay canary label, smoke script, and the namespace rename. requesting @Sam H and @Matt K for review. if deploy-bot plan looks green and no objections, i'll merge during GMT morning window :thumbsup:
Sam H: +1 from me, will check the RBAC snippets in the PR
Matt K: +1, happy to help with state mv if needed
Anika S: done — PR opened: infra#4128. plan ran in CI and is green. anyone object to me merging after sam approves?
Linh T: no objections from infra side. add a rollback note in the PR description just in case
Anika S: added rollback steps and `kubectl apply -f overlays/staging/rollback.yaml` snippet. merging after sam review. thanks all :raised_hands:
